method: preview_strategy_report over 12 ranked CRYPTO coins, one timepoint, anchor 1h
why: The platform publishes a conditionVocabulary per categorical header. For two classifyZone
columns that published set is disjoint from reality: the column never emits any label it
declares, and the platform refuses every label it does emit.
So there is no label that works. A condition on ADX_zone or MFI14_zone is either rejected at
validation (CONDITION_LITERAL_UNSUPPORTED) or FALSE forever. omega therefore refuses the whole
clause and points at the numeric replacement, which was verified live to reproduce the zone
exactly. The observed set is a measurement used to DETECT this, never to widen what is legal -
widening would emit payloads the platform rejects.

ADX_zone.verdict: DISJOINT - no declared label was ever emitted

MFI14_zone.verdict: DISJOINT - no declared label was ever emitted

platformRejectsObservedLabels.response: VALIDATION_ERROR CONDITION_LITERAL_UNSUPPORTED - "'trending' is not a value 'ADX_zone' can take - its vocabulary is overbought | oversold | neutral. Nearest canonical key: 'oversold'."
platformRejectsObservedLabels.consequence: There is no label that works. The platform refuses every label the column emits and evaluates every label it accepts as FALSE. ADX_zone and MFI14_zone cannot carry a condition at all - they are display-only columns.

workaround.rule: Replace the categorical zone column with its underlying numeric column and threshold on it.

inferredCutoffs.note: CONSISTENT WITH the observations, not extracted from the platform. The zone thresholds are not published anywhere; these are the boundaries the observed pairs imply, and they match the conventional ADX 20/25 and MFI 50 midline. Treat as a starting point and re-measure before relying on an edge case.

crowdRankWorkaround.finding: CROWD x rank compiles (header crowdAcc_rank_hi) but never renders. Tested 1 coin and 10 coins, ordering hi and lo, with complete non-null data across every coin. INTERNAL_ERROR in all variants.
crowdRankWorkaround.contractDifference: Crowd ranks are documented as 'ordinal across THIS REPORT's coins ... computed per request', unlike every other rank which reads the tracked universe. The per-request path is what fails.
crowdRankWorkaround.rule: Use CROWD_* x value directly. Crowd metrics are already cross-coin-comparable percentages (0-100), so unlike VOLUME they need no normalisation - the rank transform adds nothing a threshold cannot express.
crowdRankWorkaround.verifiedLive: condition crowdAcc between 60 and 100 resolved UP on SOL (88.9) and XRP (100.0), NEITHER on BTC (40.0)
